comments.body:
Hey, I'm Swiss since birth but with a bit of a darker skin-tone. From my own experience growing up in this country: 

It is difficult to integrate in Switzerland in general, the Swiss (I feel) generally maintain smaller friend circles but also bond much closer with the friends they do have. This means you're naturally going to have a rough start here especially when you're "too nice" which can come across as fake.

I for example also like to keep work relationships professional, occasionally someone may become a good friend but that's rare. A colleague that does not make that same distinction may be off-putting.

The whatsapp remarks can be explained by:

1. Something did not happen before
2. You join
3. It happens now

It would only be logical to ask you first and personally I don't see this as problematic unless the tone is really uncalled for.
comments.author: isam2k
